lines: Ahh, a young visionary! I can always tell. It's the shoes.
Goldwhistle's the name. Bartholomew Goldwhistle. I own things. Lots of things. That house, for one.
I hear you're after a water slide, and the mayor said no. Pfft! Mayors. Think outside the box!
Why squeeze a slide onto a waterfall when you could have a whole HOUSE of slide? Stairs? Slide. Hallway? Slide. Bathtub? Big slide.
It's been for sale for three hundred years. Bit of a fixer-upper. Go on, try the door! It's only a LITTLE bit haunted.
The front door, young visionary! It sticks a bit. Give it a good push.
(He takes a big step back. And then another one.)
Think outside the box! Or inside a different box. Either way, there's a box.
